blocks.prompt: 1. Find the 6th term of the G.P.: \(-6, -3, \frac{-3}{2}, \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh seedha sa G.P. ka sawal hai: pehle chand terms diye hain aur humein ek khaas term chahiye.
Diya kya hai? Sequence \(-6, -3, -\frac{3}{2}, \ldots\)
Find kya karna hai? 6th term, yani \(a_6\).
Plan: pehla term parhenge, do saath wale terms ko divide kar ke common ratio (mushtarka nisbat) \(r\) nikalenge, phir \(a_n = a_1 r^{n-1}\) lagayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: G.P. \(-6, -3, -\frac{3}{2}, \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: 6th term \(a_6\).
Tareeqa: G.P. mein har term pichle term ko ek hi number \(r\) se multiply karne par banta hai. Is liye formula \(a_n = a_1 r^{n-1}\) hai. Bas do cheezein chahiye: pehla term aur \(r\). Yeh formula is liye fit hai ke humein seedha 6th term chahiye, saari list likhne ki zaroorat nahi.

Pehla term parhein aur \(r\) nikalein
\[a_1 = -6\]
\[r = \dfrac{a_2}{a_1} = \dfrac{-3}{-6} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: Common ratio hamesha "agla term taqseem pichla term" hota hai. Yahan dono terms negative hain, aur minus ko minus se divide karein to plus aata hai, is liye \(r\) positive \(\frac{1}{2}\) hai. Har term pichle ka aadha hai.
Dhyan dein: \(r = a_1 / a_2\) ulta mat likhiye; is se \(r = 2\) aa jayega jo ghalat hai.

Agle jore se \(r\) ki tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{a_3}{a_2} = \dfrac{-3/2}{-3} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: G.P. ki pehchan hi yeh hai ke har jore ka ratio barabar ho. Ek dafa check kar lene se pakka ho jata hai ke sequence waqai G.P. hai aur humara \(r\) sahi hai.

\(n = 6\) rakh kar general term lagayein
\[a_6 = a_1 r^{5}\]
\[= (-6)\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^{5}\]
\[= -\dfrac{6}{32} = -\dfrac{3}{16}\]
Kyun: 6th term ke liye power \(n - 1 = 5\) hoti hai, kyunke pehle term tak pohanchne ke liye koi multiply nahi hota, phir har agle term ke liye ek dafa \(r\) lagta hai. \(2^5 = 32\), aur \(6/32\) ko 2 se chhota karne par \(3/16\) bacha.
Dhyan dein: Power 6 nahi, 5 hai; yeh G.P. ki sab se aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq: list aage barha kar dekhein
\[-6,\ -3,\ -\tfrac{3}{2},\ -\tfrac{3}{4},\ -\tfrac{3}{8},\ -\tfrac{3}{16}\]
Kyun: \(-6\) ko paanch dafa aadha karne se bhi chhata term \(-\frac{3}{16}\) hi aaya. Formula aur list dono ek hi jawab de rahe hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.
